q-184001.name: Question 1
q-184001.problem:
Suppose $n=-2p+6q-10,$ where $p,q\in Z.$ Complete the following argument.

The number $n$ is {{field-1}} since 

$$
\begin{aligned}n & =-2p+6q-10 \\  & =2({{field-2}}-5) \\  & ={{field-3}},\end{aligned}
$$

where $a=${{field-4}}.
q-184001.worked_solution:
An integer is *even* if it can be written as $2a,$ where $a$ is an integer.

Notice that all terms in the expression $-2p+6q-10$ have a common factor of $2.$ 

Therefore, we complete our argument as follows:

The number $n$ is $\text{even}$ since

$$
\begin{aligned}n & =-2p+6q-10 \\  & =2({{-p+3q-5}_{⏟}}_{a}) \\  & =2a,\end{aligned}
$$

where $a=-p+3q-5\in Z.$

q-184078.problem:
Suppose $n=20{m}^{5}+16m-5,$ where $m\in Z.$ Complete the following argument.

The number $n$ is {{field-1}} since 

$$
\begin{aligned}n & =20{m}^{5}+16m-5 \\  & =2(10{m}^{5}+{{field-2}})+1 \\  & ={{field-3}},\end{aligned}
$$

where $a=$ {{field-4}} is an integer.
q-184078.worked_solution:
An integer is *odd* if it can be written as $2a+1,$ where $a$ is an integer.

Now, note the following regarding the expression $20{m}^{5}+16m-5:$

- All terms, apart from the constant term, have a common factor of $2.$

- The constant term can be written as $-5=-6+1.$

Therefore, we complete our argument as follows:

The number $n$ is $\text{odd}$ since

$$
\begin{aligned}n & =20{m}^{5}+16m-5 \\  & =(20{m}^{5}+16m-6)+1 \\  & =2({{10{m}^{5}+8m-3}_{⏟}}_{a})+1 \\  & =2a+1,\end{aligned}
$$

where $a=10{m}^{5}+8m-3$ is an integer.

q-184085.worked_solution:
An integer is *odd* if it can be written as $2a+1,$ where $a$ is an integer.

Now, note the following regarding the expression $6{p}^{2}-8pq+2{q}^{2}+3:$

- All terms, apart from the constant term, have a common factor of $2.$

- The constant term can be written as $3=2+1.$

Therefore, we complete our argument as follows:

The number $n$ is $\text{odd}$ since

$$
\begin{aligned}n & =6{p}^{2}-8pq+2{q}^{2}+3 \\  & =(6{p}^{2}-8pq+2{q}^{2}+2)+1 \\  & =2({{3{p}^{2}-4pq+{q}^{2}+1}_{⏟}}_{a})+1 \\  & =2a+1,\end{aligned}
$$

where $a=3{p}^{2}-4pq+{q}^{2}+1\in Z.$
